notes: Sunflower oil is usually available at ethnic stores. If not available, it can be substituted for any vegetable oil, although that will change the authentic taste.
A chopped green onion or a couple can be optionally added to the mix for a "greener" taste.
The salad should better be all used up at once; the taste starts to deteriorate after a few hours.

title: Rib Rub
instructions: 1. Combine all ingredients in a container with a shaker lid.
ingredient_lines: 3 tbsp cayenne pepper (or adjust to taste)

title: Memphis-Style BBQ Ribs
instructions:
1. Season spareribs with rib rub.
2. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
3. Place chunks in smoker or charcoal grill set for indirect heat at 250°F (120°C).
4. Combine liquid ingredients and bring to a boil over high heat.
5. Reduce liquid by ⅓.
6. Place spareribs into smoker or grill for 4–5 hours, basting occasionally with sauce.
7. Brush remaining sauce on top of ribs and place on a medium-high grill until browned. The internal temperature of the ribs before removing from the grill needs to be at least 145°F (63°C).
8. Let rest for 10 minutes, covered, and carve.

title: Hot Wings
instructions:
1. To make the sauce, combine melted butter, hot sauce, minced garlic, and soy sauce in a stainless steel bowl.
2. Preheat oil to 350°F (180°C).
3. Combine seasoning salt, pepper, and wings. Toss to coat.
4. Fry wings in batches in oil for 11 minutes. Drain on a rack. Do not use paper towels—they will make the food greasy.
5. Toss wings with sauce and serve warm.
ingredient_lines: 12 whole chicken wings, tip removed and cut in half

title: Backyard BBQ Chicken
instructions:
1. Combine dry ingredients and rub onto chicken.
2. Refrigerate 1 hour.
3. Combine liquid ingredients, bring to a boil, and simmer until reduced by ⅓.
4. Place on medium grill, and turn often, brushing with sauce when turned until interior temperature reaches 165 °F.
5. Let rest for 10 minutes; serve.
ingredient_lines: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts and drumsticks

title: Chipotle BBQ Sauce
instructions:
1. Whisk together oil and flour and cook on medium heat, stirring constantly until light blonde color is achieved.
2. Add remaining ingredients and bring to a boil; reduce heat to low and cook 15 minutes.
3. Cool for 15 minutes and purée in batches until smooth.
4. Store in nonreactive container for up to 1 week.
ingredient_lines: 2 cans chipotle in adobo including all of adobo sauce

title: Chipotle BBQ Rub
instructions: 1. Combine all ingredients and keep in airtight container in cool, dark place.

title: Chipotle BBQ Ribs
instructions:
1. Season ribs with BBQ rub. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
2. Combine BBQ sauce with molasses.
3. Place hickory chunks into a 325–350°F smoker or in a charcoal grill set for indirect heat at 325–350°F.
4. Place ribs into smoker or grill and cook for 3–4 hours, brushing with molasses mixture often.
5. Brush ribs with remaining sauce and place on a medium-high grill and sear until well-browned.
6. Let sit for 15 minutes; serve.

title: Barbecue Chicken Rub
instructions: 1. Combine all ingredients in an airtight container.
ingredient_lines: ¼ cup (35 g) dry mustard powder
¾ cup (140 g) turbinado or light brown sugar

title: Cola BBQ Sauce
instructions:
1. Combine all ingredients and bring to a boil.
2. Cook over high heat for 10 minutes.
3. Store refrigerated in a nonreactive container for up to 1 week.
ingredient_lines: 1 ½ cans good cola (Pepsi is recommended)

title: Cola BBQ Chicken
instructions:
1. Season chicken with Rub.
2. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
3. Preheat grill for medium heat.
4. Place chicken on grill and turn often, basting with sauce every time the chicken is turned until internal temperature reaches 165°F inside the breast and 170°F in the drumstick.
5. Rest 15 minutes; serve.
ingredient_lines: 4 each boneless skinless chicken breasts and chicken drumsticks

attribution: Wikibooks — Cookbook:Beef Burgers with Chipotle Mayo
title: Beef Burgers with Chipotle Mayo
instructions:
1. Mix all ingredients for the chipotle mayo and refrigerate until needed.
2. Shape ground chuck into 4 patties. Sprinkle patties with kosher salt, black pepper, and cayenne pepper.
3. Place patties on a well-oiled medium grill and cook until internal temperature reaches 160°F (>70°C) for medium doneness. If using cheese, place on patties and cover for 1 minute to melt the cheese.
4. Spread chipotle mayo onto buns and sandwich the burgers with the halves. Serve.

title: Steak Rub
instructions: 1. Combine all ingredients in an airtight container with a shaker lid.
ingredient_lines: ¼ cup (40 g) coarsely ground black pepper

attribution: Wikibooks — Cookbook:Grilled Filet Mignon with a Cognac Reduction
title: Grilled Filet Mignon with a Cognac Reduction
instructions:
1. Sprinkle filet mignons with kosher salt on both sides.
2. Coat filet mignons with mustard on both sides and press into the black pepper, pressing lightly to help adhesion.
3. Grill steaks over high heat for 1 minute per side, then place on a new medium burner until interior temperature reaches 140°F (60°C). Remove and keep warm.
4. Place cognac in a small saucepan, and boil over high heat until reduced by ⅓.
5. Serve filet mignons with cognac reduction drizzled on top.

title: Oreo Pie
instructions:
1. Begin by softening the ice cream enough to spread.
2. Mix the softened ice cream with the Cool Whip.
3. Crumble the Oreos. This can be done by putting the Oreos into a plastic bag and crushing them with a rolling pin.
4. Mix the Oreos into the ice cream mixture.
5. Spread the mixture evenly into the 3 pie crusts.
6. Freeze for at least 2 hours.
ingredient_lines: ½ gallon (1.9 litres) ice cream (usually vanilla)
3 crumb crusts (preferably Graham cracker or chocolate)

attribution: Wikibooks — Cookbook:Tangy Lemon Battered Fried Chicken
title: Tangy Lemon Battered Fried Chicken
instructions:
1. Combine paprika, salt, pepper, granulated garlic, ginger, and cayenne.
2. Moisten chicken with lemon juice and coat with seasoning mixture.
3. Dredge chicken in cornmeal and let rest 2–3 minutes only.
4. Melt shortening in a large cast iron skillet; heat to 350°F, watching carefully to prevent burning.
5. Place legs and breasts around the edges, then place thighs in the center.
6. Fry for 12 minutes, then flip to the other side and fry another 12 minutes.
7. Drain on a cooling or oven rack. Please don't use paper towels, which will make your chicken greasy.
8. Sprinkle with black pepper; serve.
ingredient_lines: 2 ea. chicken thighs, legs, and boneless breasts
notes: The reason for putting the chicken in different spots is because there is usually a hot spot in the center of the pan.
The chicken will stay rocket-hot for a good 20 minutes after frying, so do not put the chicken into an oven—it'll just make it soggy.

title: Maple-Glazed BBQ Ribs
instructions:
1. Combine seasonings and rub on pork ribs.
2. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
3. Place hickory chunks into a 350°F (175˚C) smoker or a charcoal grill set for indirect heat at 350°F.
4. Combine liquid ingredients and bring to a boil over high heat until reduced by half.
5. Place ribs in smoker/grill and cook, basting often with maple syrup mixture, for 3–4 hours
6. Brush ribs with remaining mixture and place on a medium high grill until well browned.
7. Rest 15 minutes; serve.

title: Firecracker Rub
instructions: 1. Combine all ingredients in an airtight container.

title: Firecracker Ribs
instructions:
1. Season ribs with rub, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
2. Preheat oven to 225°F (110°C).
3. Combine liquid ingredients.
4. Place ribs in a large foil pouch, pour in liquid mixture, and seal pouch.
5. Bake at 225°F (110°C) for 5–6 hours.
6. Remove ribs from pouches and set aside. Save liquid.
7. Reduce liquid by half over high heat, then lightly brush some reduction on top of ribs and place under a preheated broiler. Watch carefully and remove when nicely browned.
8. Rest 15 minutes; serve.

title: Ginger-Glazed Grilled Peaches
instructions:
1. Combine liquid ingredients in a saucepan and bring to a boil over medium high heat until reduced by half.
2. Brush peaches with melted butter and place on a medium grill until well marked, brushing with nectar mixture often.
3. Pour remaining glaze into large bowl and toss with peaches; serve.
ingredient_lines: 2 lb large peaches, peeled and halved
¼ cup crystallized ginger, finely minced

title: Spicy Fried Wings
instructions:
1. Combine all seasonings except lemon zest and then sprinkle over chicken. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
2. Combine egg and lemon zest in a pie plate and place cornmeal in another pie plate.
3. Heat oil to 350°F.
4. Dip chicken into egg mixture and then dredge in cornmeal.
5. Fry in batches for 11–12 minutes. Drain on a rack. Please don't use paper towels unless you want greasy chicken.
6. Sprinkle with red pepper flake for hotter wings, but this is completely optional. Serve.
ingredient_lines: 12 whole chicken wings, tips removed and cut in half

title: Honey BBQ Hot Wings
instructions:
1. Sprinkle wings with salt and black pepper.
2. Heat oil to 350°F (175°C).
3. Deep fry wings in batches for 11–12 minutes. Drain on a cooling rack.
4. Combine liquid ingredients except for oil.
5. Bring to a boil over medium high heat until reduced to 10 Tbsp.
6. Remove from heat and let rest for 5 minutes.
7. Toss wings with sauce; serve warm.

title: Caramelized Pineapple
instructions:
1. Combine vanilla bean and liquid ingredients except rum and ¼ cup brown sugar.
2. Heat over medium heat until sugar is dissolved and has thickened slightly, 15–30 minutes.
3. Remove vanilla pod and let the sugar mixture sit at room temperature for 30 minutes.
4. Dip pineapple into sugar mixture then dredge in remaining sugar, adding more as needed.
5. Place pineapple on a greased baking sheet and place under broiler, shaking constantly until well browned.
6. Remove pineapple; keep warm.
7. Place baking sheet on two burners and heat over high heat. Add rum and ignite. Scrape browned bits off of pan and boil rum until reduced by half.
8. Add rum to remaining sugar mixture and stir. Serve pineapple with remaining sugar mixture on the side.
ingredient_lines: ½ cup dark brown sugar, divided

title: Crispy Sweet Potato Fries
instructions:
1. Cover potatoes with water. Bring to a rolling boil and cook until tender.
2. Drain thoroughly and cold shock in a bowl of iced water. Drain again.
3. Combine syrup and vanilla; set aside.
4. Heat oil to 375°F and deep fry potatoes in batches until golden brown and crispy. Drain on a cooling rack.
5. Combine remaining ingredients and sprinkle on potatoes once all fried.
6. Warm syrup mixture in a large saucepan over low heat; toss with potatoes and serve.

attribution: Wikibooks — Cookbook:Lamb and Okra Stew (Khoresht Bamiye)
title: Lamb and Okra Stew (Khoresht Bamiye)
instructions:
1. Fry the sliced onion in oil until slightly golden.
2. Add the meat and fry with the onions until the color changes.
3. Add 3 glasses of hot water and bring to boil. Turn heat down and let boil slowly for about 45 minutes, adding more hot water during cooking if needed.
4. Add okra, salt, pepper, and tomato paste to the meat. Cook for another 10–15 minutes. Take care not to overcook the okras so that they do not become slippery.
5. Add lime juice and adjust seasoning. Cook for another 3–4 minutes.
6. Serve with white rice.
ingredient_lines: 500 grams stewing lamb or beef, cut into small pieces
750 grams okra, washed with stems trimmed
notes: If desired, potatoes can also be added to khoresht bamieh. In that case, 500 grams of potatoes should be washed, peeled and cut into small pieces, and added in with 500 grams of okra (or slightly earlier; required cooking time depends somewhat on the size of the cut pieces).

title: Tequila Lime Hot Wings
instructions:
1. Sprinkle wingettes with salt and black pepper.
2. Heat oil to 350°F. Fry wings in batches for 12 minutes. Drain on a rack.
3. Combine remaining ingredients and boil over high heat until reduced by ⅓.
4. Toss wings with sauce mixture and serve warm.

title: Backyard Barbecue Ribs
instructions:
1. Combine dry seasoning and rub on pork ribs. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
2. Place hickory chunks in a 250 °F (120 °C) smoker or a 250 °F (120 °C) charcoal grill set for indirect heat.
3. Combine remaining ingredients, bring to a boil over high heat, and simmer until reduced by ¾.
4. Place ribs in smoker/grill and cook 5–6 hours.
5. Brush ribs with tomato mixture and place on a high grill, turning and brushing often until well browned.
6. Remove and let sit for 10 minutes; serve.

title: North Carolina-Style BBQ Ribs
instructions:
1. Season ribs with Rib Rub and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
2. Combine remaining ingredients and place in a spray bottle.
3. Place ribs in a 250°F smoker or a charcoal grill set for indirect heat at 250°F
4. Cook for 5–6 hours, spraying often with vinegar mixture.
5. Spray heavily with vinegar mixture and place on a high grill, turning and spraying constantly until well browned.
6. Remove and let rest 15 minutes; serve.
notes: There will be extra vinegar mixture. You can use it for almost anything including beef briskets.

title: Rosemary Garlic Strip Steak
instructions:
1. Rub steaks with garlic on both sides and coat with olive oil.
2. Sprinkle steaks with salt and black pepper and place on the highest heat you can get with your grill. Place rosemary on top of each steak.
3. Sear 2–3 minutes per side and move to medium grill temperature. Cook until internal temperature reaches desired "doneness".
4. Let rest 10 minutes; slice thinly across the grain on a bias and serve.

title: Grilled Ribeye Steak
instructions:
1. Combine all rub ingredients.
2. Coat steaks with mustard and apply rub to steaks.
3. Refrigerate for 30 minutes.
4. Heat a grill as high as it will go.
5. Place steaks on grill and cook 2–3 minutes per side.
6. Move steaks to medium grill heat. Cook until desired doneness, turning frequently.
7. Remove and let rest 10 minutes; slice thinly across the grain on a bias and serve.
ingredient_lines: ½–1 tsp cayenne pepper (depending on how spicy you like it)
2 bone-in ribeye steaks (sometimes called a rib steak)

title: Pulled Pork Sandwiches
instructions:
1. Combine water, salt, and honey in a 6-quart cooler. Add pork and refrigerate or place a large bag of ice on top for 8–12 hours.
2. Remove pork from brine and pat dry with paper towels. Combine remaining seasonings and rub on pork.
3. Light a few chunks of apple wood and place in the firebox of a smoker. Keep temperature in smoker around 210°F.
4. Place in a smoker and cook for 8–12 hours, changing wood as needed. The meat should be tender at this point—if not, continue smoking.
5. Let rest 1 hour, then shred with two forks. Serve on hamburger buns.
ingredient_lines: 2 tbsp cayenne pepper (more if you like)

attribution: Wikibooks — Cookbook:Pork Roast with Cayenne Apple Glaze
title: Pork Roast with Cayenne Apple Glaze
instructions:
1. Combine dry powders. Set aside.
2. Smear mustard as needed on one end of each roast. Attach mustard ends of roasts together.
3. Spread remaining mustard all over roasts. Apply dry powder mixture.
4. Bake at 375°F until internal temperature reaches 135°F.
5. Combine remaining ingredients and brush onto pork.
6. Bake at 375°F until internal temperature reaches 145°F (yes, it is safe).
7. Let rest for 10 minutes; serve.

title: Cheesy Mascarpone Cornbread Stuffing
instructions:
1. Combine all ingredients except for cream and ¼ cup mascarpone cheese.
2. Gently fold in cream.
3. Bake in a 350°F (175°C) oven for 30–35 minutes.
4. Spread remaining cheese on top and place under a preheated broiler until browned and bubbly.
5. Cool 10 minutes; serve.
ingredient_lines: 2 cups heavy cream, whipped to soft peaks

attribution: Wikibooks — Cookbook:Meatballs with Honey Lime Sauce
title: Meatballs with Honey Lime Sauce
instructions:
1. Combine beef, salt, pepper, red pepper flakes, ¼ cup breadcrumbs, rosemary, thyme, and egg.
2. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
3. Shape into 1-ounce balls and dredge meatballs in remaining breadcrumbs.
4. Melt butter in your largest sauté pan over low heat.
5. Raise the heat to medium. Place balls in skillet, working in batches if needed. Cook until well-browned with an internal temperature of 160 °F.
6. Place meatballs in a 200°F oven to keep warm.
7. Deglaze pan with broth. Add honey and lime juice, and boil until reduced by ¼.
8. Return meatballs to pan and toss to coat.
9. Serve warm.
category_tags: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

title: Honey Lime Pork Loin
instructions:
1. Heat oil in a large sauté pan over high heat. Add roast and cook until thoroughly browned on all sides.
2. Remove from pan and keep warm. Add broth and deglaze pan, stirring to remove browned bits.
3. Place roast in a greased roasting pan and rub with seasonings.
4. Reduce chicken broth by half.
5. Combine chicken broth with wine and Worcestershire sauce and pour over pork.
6. Insert an oven-safe probe thermometer in the roast and bake at 275°F (135°C) until internal temperature reaches 145°F (63°C). Keep warm.
7. Place cooking liquid in the refrigerator until fat has solidified. Remove and discard fat.
8. Stir in honey and lime juice. Set aside.
9. Melt butter over medium heat in a large saucepan. Whisk in flour and cook, stirring constantly until light blonde color is achieved.
10. Add cooking liquid mixture to the pan and boil until reduced by ⅓.
11. Rewarm pork, if needed. Slice and serve with sauce.
category_tags: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

title: Sauteed Morels
instructions:
1. Sprinkle mushrooms and onion with salt and black pepper.
2. Heat oil in large sauté pan over medium high heat.
3. Add garlic and cook 30–45 seconds. Add remaining ingredients and cook for 7–10 more minutes.
4. Remove from pan and drizzle with pan juices. Serve.

title: Molasses-Glazed Pork Chops
instructions:
1. Place pork chops in a large zip-top bag. Combine liquid ingredients and pour into bag. Marinate in the fridge for at least 30 minutes.
2. Take pork out of marinade. Combine dry seasonings and rub on pork. Heat your grill as high as it will go.
3. Boil marinade for 10 minutes.
4. Place pork on grill and cook 2 minutes, brushing with marinade, before rotating 90 degrees to get nice grill marks. Cook another 2 minutes, brushing.
5. Flip to the other side and repeat. Remove from grill and let rest for 10 minutes. Serve with additional marinade.

title: Barbecue Rub
instructions: 1. Combine all ingredients in an airtight container.
ingredient_lines: ¼ cup (30 g) dehydrated lemon peel

title: Grilled Pork Loin
instructions:
1. Combine mustard and vinegar, and rub all over pork.
2. Coat pork evenly with the Barbecue Rub.
3. Grill on a preheated grill, turning often until internal temperature reaches 145°F (63˚C).
4. Remove and let rest for 10 minutes. Serve.

title: Cognac Beef Stew
instructions:
1. Dredge beef in flour. Heat oil in a 6-quart Dutch oven.
2. Working in batches, add beef and thoroughly brown on all sides.
3. Remove beef and add cognac. Bring to a boil and ignite.
4. Deglaze pan by scraping the bottom.
5. Once reduced by half, remove and pour over beef.
6. Melt butter over medium heat and add onion. Cook 1–2 minutes before adding garlic. Sauté until pale gold color is achieved.
7. Add everything else, place in a 250°F (120C) oven, and bake 5 hours.
8. Let rest 10 minutes and serve.
ingredient_lines: 2 pounds (1 kg) beef stew meat, cut into 2 in. (5 cm) cubes
½ pound (225 g) red-skinned potatoes, quartered
category_tags: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

title: Country Roast Chicken Seasoning
instructions: 1. Combine all ingredients in an airtight container.

title: Country Roast Chicken
instructions:
1. Loosen skin from chicken. Rub flesh with chicken seasoning.
2. Place lemon slices in the bottom of a roasting pan and place chicken on top.
3. Stuff chicken cavity with thyme, rosemary, and lemon wedges.
4. Place 1 tbsp butter under the skin of each breast.
5. Insert an oven-safe probe thermometer into the breast but not touching the butter.
6. Bake in a 325°F oven until breast internal temperature reaches 165°F and thigh meat reaches 170°F.
7. Cover with foil and let rest 10 minutes; serve.
ingredient_lines: 1 ea. (3 lbs) broiler/fryer chicken, giblets removed
¼ cup Country Roast Chicken Seasoning

title: Campfire Barbecue Chicken Wings
instructions:
1. Combine cayenne, salt, and pepper, and toss with wings. Refrigerate.
2. Combine sauce ingredients. Heat in a microwave until warm and well mixed. Allow to cool.
3. Brush wings on all sides with about ¾ of the sauce (or just put ¾ of the sauce in a ziplock with the wings) and refrigerate as long as possible.
4. Grill until internal temperature reaches 165 °F.
5. Remove to a plate and cover. Let rest 5 minutes before serving with the remaining ¼ of the sauce.

title: Spicy Apple Glazed Ribs
instructions:
1. Season pork with barbecue rub, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
2. Combine wet ingredients and bring to a boil over high heat 5–10 minutes. Set aside.
3. Place ribs in a 250°F smoker or a 250°F charcoal grill set for indirect heat and cook 5–6 hours or until meat falls off the bone.
4. Brush generously with cider mixture and place on a medium high grill, turning and brushing with cider mixture until well browned.
5. Remove and let rest 10 minutes. Serve with remaining cider mixture.

title: Beef Carpaccio II
instructions:
1. Cover the meat tightly with plastic wrap, then freeze for up to two hours to help with slicing. Don't freeze for any longer, or else it'll be mushy.
2. Slice the meat thinly and remove plastic wrap.
3. Place five slices in a rough circle and put one in the center. Lift to a lightly water-spritzed sheet of plastic wrap. Spritz another sheet with water and place on top. Place a pie pan on top and lightly pound with a food can.
4. Remove and sprinkle with kosher salt and black pepper. Serve with extra-virgin olive oil, lemon wedges, shaved Parmiggiano-Reggiano cheese, and basil chiffonade.

attribution: Wikibooks — Cookbook:Pan-Seared Scallops with Cayenne Chocolate Sauce
title: Pan-Seared Scallops with Cayenne Chocolate Sauce
instructions:
1. Sprinkle scallops with salt and black pepper.
2. Melt butter in a large stainless steel skillet over medium heat. Place scallops in and cook 30 seconds per side. Remove and put on a platter.
3. Whisk together chocolate and cayenne pepper. Drizzle on individual plates, place scallops on top, garnish with fresh parsley, and serve.
ingredient_lines: 1 tbsp ground cayenne pepper (adjust to your liking)

title: Roasted Redskin Potatoes
instructions:
1. Put potatoes and bay leaves in a large Dutch oven. Put enough water to cover and bring to a rolling boil. Cook for 15 minutes or until tender.
2. Drain and shock. Drain again and discard bay leaves. Pat dry with paper towels.
3. Whisk together oil and remaining ingredients. Add potatoes and toss to coat.
4. Bake in a 425°F oven for 10 minutes or until lightly to deeply brown. Serve.

attribution: Wikibooks — Cookbook:Maple Cumin Glazed Grilled Bananas
title: Maple Cumin Glazed Grilled Bananas
instructions:
1. Spray bananas and cold grill grate with nonstick cooking spray.
2. Place a large saucepan over high heat and add rum. Ignite. Once flames have died, remove from heat and whisk in remaining ingredients.
3. Place bananas cut side down on the preheated grill, and brush with rum mixture. Cook for 2 minutes, then flip and brush grilled side with more rum mixture.
4. Cook other side until well browned. Flip and cook just until browned. Remove and serve.

title: Kansas City Barbecue Sauce
instructions:
1. Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan, and bring to a boil over high heat.
2. Cook, stirring often for 15 minutes.
3. Cool, and keep refrigerated in a nonreactive container for up to 2 months.

title: Smoky Chipotle Hot Sauce
instructions: 1. Combine all ingredients and store in a nonreactive container at room temperature for up to 2 months.

attribution: Wikibooks — Cookbook:Smoky Chipotle Glazed Hot Wings
title: Smoky Chipotle Glazed Hot Wings
instructions:
1. Heat oil to 350°F. Fry wings in batches for 12 minutes each batch. Drain on a rack.
2. Combine remaining ingredients, add wings, and toss to coat. Serve.

title: Whiskey Barbecue Sauce
instructions:
1. Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil over high heat and cook, stirring, for 10 minutes.
2. Refrigerate in a nonreactive container for up to 2 months.
category_tags: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

title: Southern Barbecue Ribs
instructions:
1. Season ribs with the barbecue rub. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
2. Place chunks into the firebox of a 250°F smoker or the coal area of a 250°F charcoal grill set for indirect heat.
3. Place ribs into food box or on top of the grate of the charcoal grill, cover, and cook, basting often with sauce, for 5–6 hours.
4. Brush sauce generously on top and bottom of ribs then place on a medium high grill, continually brushing with sauce until well browned, then flip and repeat 1 more time.
5. Place remaining sauce into a squirt bottle. Meanwhile, remove ribs and let rest for 10 minutes.
6. Serve with sauce in a squirt bottle.
ingredient_lines: 2 slabs St. Louis style/cut pork spareribs

title: Asian Barbecue Ribs
instructions:
1. Peel off the thin membrane on each rib. Season ribs with the barbecue rub and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
2. Place hickory chunks in the firebox of a 250°F (120°C) smoker.
3. Combine remaining ingredients in a large sauce pan over high heat and bring to a boil. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes or until slightly thickened. Set aside.
4. Place ribs in smoker and cook for 5–6 hours, brushing with soy mixture often.
5. Brush meat sides generously with soy mixture and place under a preheated broiler until deeply browned. Watch carefully or it will burn!
6. Slice into 1-rib portions and serve.
ingredient_lines: 2 slabs St. Louis style/cut pork spareribs

title: Tequila Lime Strip Steak
instructions:
1. Combine liquid ingredients and salt in a gallon zip-top freezer bag. Add steaks and squeeze as much air out as possible. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
2. Remove steaks from marinade and discard extra. Place steak rub in a pie pan and add steaks, pressing lightly to help adhesion on both sides.
3. Spray cold grill grate with nonstick cooking spray. Set up for direct and indirect heat and add some soaked mesquite chips to the coals.
4. Place steaks on hottest part of grill and cook for 2–3 minutes per side. Move to the cooler part of the grill and cook, turning once, until internal temperature reaches 10° cooler than your preferred doneness. Remove and let rest for 7 minutes. Slice thinly across the grain on a bias and serve.

attribution: Wikibooks — Cookbook:Ginger Peach Glazed BBQ Ribs
title: Ginger Peach Glazed BBQ Ribs
instructions:
1. Season ribs with the Barbecue Rub. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
2. Place applewood in the firebox of a 250°F smoker or in the coal area of a 250°F charcoal grill set for indirect heat.
3. Combine remaining ingredients and bring to a boil over high heat until reduced by ⅓. Cover tightly and set aside.
4. Place ribs in smoker/on top of grill grate and cook, brushing often with preserve mixture, for 5–6 hours.
5. Brush ribs generously with preserve mixture and place on a medium high grill and cook, repeatedly brushing side facing you, until well browned. Repeat one more time.
6. Remove and let rest 10 minutes; slice into 1-rib portions and serve.
ingredient_lines: 2 slabs St. Louis style/cut pork spareribs

title: Chop Rub
instructions: 1. Combine all ingredients and store in a cool, dark place in an airtight container.
ingredient_lines: 2 tsp hickory smoke powder (if you can't find this, use 2 drops liquid smoke in the dish.)

title: Apple Crusted Ham
instructions:
1. Place ham in a large roasting pan large side down.
2. Bake at 250°F for 1 hour.
3. Take ham out from oven and brush generously with cola. Pat on the chop rub, and then pat on apples.
4. Bake for another 1 ½ hours at 250°F
5. Remove and let rest 10 minutes. Slice thinly and serve.
ingredient_lines: 1 bone-in cooked city ham, skin removed
½ cup dried apples, minced finely

title: Grilled Pork Chops
instructions:
1. Combine honey, salt, vinegar, rosemary, thyme, cayenne pepper, and minced garlic in a plastic zip-top bag. Add ice, and shake the bag until ice is mostly melted and mixture has cooled down.
2. Insert pork chops into the bag, and refrigerate for 1–2 hours.
3. Combine cracked peppercorns, paprika, and chili powder.
4. Take the pork out of the mixture and pat dry with paper towels. Discard remaining marinade.
5. Rub pepper mixture on both sides of each pork chop.
6. Quickly grease a high-heat grill with a flame-resistant towel soaked in oil and tied with twine.
7. Grill pork chops, covered, 2 minutes. Rotate 90 degrees, and cook for another 2 minutes. Flip and repeat this process on the other side.
8. Move to a plate and let rest, uncovered, for 5 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Spice Rub
instructions:
1. Combine all ingredients in an airtight container.
2. Stored in a cool, dark place this will last for a long time.

title: Mascarpone Glazed Strawberries
instructions:
1. Melt butter in your largest stainless steel sauté pan over medium heat. Add strawberries and cook until deeply browned. Remove and keep warm.
2. Deglaze pan with rum and ignite. Stir to dissolve browned bits.
3. Add remaining ingredients, and boil until reduced by ⅓.
4. Add strawberries, reduce heat to low, and cook ½ hour.
5. Remove pan from heat and serve.
ingredient_lines: 1 pound fresh strawberries, hulled and sliced

title: Vanilla Fudge I
instructions:
1. Line a deep tray with grease-proof paper.
2. Combine the white sugar, syrup, condensed milk and butter together in a saucepan.
3. Cook on a medium level of heat on the stove and bring to boil. Stirring constantly (so it doesn’t burn), cook for 5 minutes after it reaches boiling point.
4. Remove the fudge from the heat and beat in the vanilla extract.
5. Pour the fudge into the tray and leave to cool until set.
6. Cut fudge into pieces.
7. Enjoy!

title: Banana Split II
instructions:
1. Peel the banana, cut it in half (length wise), and place it in the serving bowl.
2. Place three full scoops of ice-cream in-between the two pieces of banana.
3. Cover the whole thing with a generous serving of whipped cream.
4. Cover that with a generous serve of ice-cream topping of your choice.
5. Sprinkle some hundreds and thousands of sprinkles over the top of all of that.
6. Place a maraschino cherry on top.

title: Sweet Omelette
instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 180°C.
2. Crack the eggs and separate the egg yolk from the egg whites.
3. Place the egg whites into the bowl, and whip the egg whites with a whisk until soft and fluffy.
4. Briefly whisk the egg yolks, then gently fold them into the whipped whites.
5. Pour into a frying pan over low heat, and cook slowly on the stove until the bottom is golden brown.
6. Place the frying pan into the oven after taking it off the stove, and bake until it is golden brown on the top.
7. Pull out of the oven and unmold onto a plate.
8. Pour and spread the jam gently over the omelette. Sift some icing sugar over the top of it.
9. Enjoy!

title: Vanilla Fudge II
instructions:
1. Line a baking tray with foil (extending it beyond the tray), and grease it up with some butter.
2. In the saucepan, combine the sugar, milk, and butter.
3. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly.
4. Cook for 5 minutes after reaching the boiling point, stirring the mixture constantly so it doesn’t burn.
5. Remove it from the heat.
6. Add the marshmallow crème, white chocolate, pecans, and the vanilla extract. Stir the mixture until smooth.
7. Pour into the tray, and leave to cool to room temperature.
8. Refrigerate until firm, then cut into pieces.
9. Enjoy!

title: Tiramisu (Non-Alcoholic)
instructions:
1. Scoop out cream filling from inside of Twinkies and place halves in a 9x9-inch high-sided square baking pan in a flat layer and top with espresso. Discard cream.
2. Combine egg yolks, cheese, and sugar. Drain excess espresso from Twinkies. Pour cheese mixture over Twinkies and smooth with an offset spatula.
3. Place as much cocoa powder as you think you'll need into a sifter or container with a shaker lid and liberally dust on top of cheese. Serve.

title: Lemon Mayonnaise
instructions:
1. Whisk together all ingredients except for oil in a large bowl.
2. One tablespoon at a time, slowly drizzle in oil while continually and vigorously whisking. Do not stop whisking, or the mayonnaise may separate.
3. Keep refrigerated for up to 3 weeks in a nonreactive container.
ingredient_lines: ½ cup extra-virgin olive oil, divided

title: Applewood Bacon
instructions:
1. In a large pot, bring to apple cider to boil. Stir in salt and sugar until dissolved.
2. Transfer cider mixture to a very large container, and add iced water.
3. Once ice has melted and brine is cool enough, submerge the pork belly in the brine.
4. Refrigerate for 3 days.
5. Remove belly, and place on top of a running box fan for 30 minutes per side to dry out.
6. Place dry applewood chunks in the firebox of a cold smoker.
7. Insert pork belly and smoke for 3–4 hours.
8. Remove from smoker and place in the freezer for up to 2 hours.
9. Slice bacon as thick or as thin as you like, and cook or refrigerate for up to 3 weeks.
ingredient_lines: 1 pork belly from the loin end

title: Chipotle BBQ Chicken Nuggets
instructions:
1. Place cornmeal in a pie pan and lemon juice in another pie pan.
2. Dip chicken pieces in lemon juice then season with BBQ rub. Dip again in lemon juice.
3. Dredge pieces, three at a time, in the cornmeal, then dip in lemon juice again then dredge again in cornmeal.
4. Heat oil to 350°F and fry pieces in batches for 6 minutes. Drain on a cooling rack but not paper towels.
5. Sprinkle with black pepper and serve.
ingredient_lines: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves, cut into 1 ½ in pieces

title: Seasoned Salt I
instructions: 1. Combine all ingredients in an airtight container. Stored in a cool dark place, this will keep indefinitely.
ingredient_lines: ¼ cup (30 g) dehydrated lemon peel

title: Mascarpone Mac 'n Cheese
instructions:
1. Melt butter in a large saucepan over medium heat. Whisk in flour and cook until light blond color is achieved.
2. Add remaining ingredients except for macaroni and whipped cream. Bring to a boil until reduced by half. Remove from heat and gently fold in cream.
3. Place macaroni in the bottom of a 9x13-inch square baking pan. Pour cheese mixture over and bake in a 350°F oven for 25 minutes, or until bubbly on top and puffed up. Remove and serve.
ingredient_lines: 1 cup heavy whipping cream, whipped to soft peaks

title: Cheese on Toast
instructions:
1. Toast one side of the bread under a medium broiler.
2. Lightly toast the other side of the bread, just enough to warm it, then spread the grated cheese over it. Add desired toppings.
3. Broil the cheesy side of the bread until the cheese is bubbling and brown.
4. Eat quickly, but be careful, as the cheese will be tongue-burningly hot!

title: Pan-Seared Pork Chops
instructions:
1. Brush pork chops with cider vinegar. Season each pork chop with the chop rub, pressing lightly.
2. Heat oil in a very large oven-proof cast iron or stainless steel skillet over medium high heat. Add pork chops and sear for 3 minutes per side.
3. Insert an oven-safe probe thermometer into one pork chop and place pan in a 350°F oven. Bake until internal temperature reaches 145°F.
4. Remove and let rest for 5 minutes; serve.

title: Chipotle Lime Hot Wings
instructions:
1. Heat oil to 350°F. Meanwhile, sprinkle wingettes with kosher salt and black pepper.
2. Fry wingettes in batches for 12 minutes. Drain on a cooling rack.
3. Combine remaining ingredients in a bowl large enough to toss wingettes. Add wingettes and toss to coat. Serve.
ingredient_lines: ¼ cup Smoky Chipotle Hot Sauce

title: Cappucino Mousse
instructions:
1. Combine espresso, sugar, chocolate, salt, and chocolate syrup.
2. Gently fold in the whipped cream.
3. Chill for 20 minutes; serve.
ingredient_lines: 2 cups heavy cream, whipped to soft peaks

title: Dry Rub Barbecue Ribs
instructions:
1. Combine liquid ingredients and place in a spray bottle. Spray liberally onto one side of ribs.
2. Coat moistened side of ribs with Rub. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
3. Place applewood in the firebox of a 250°F smoker or the coal area of a 250°F charcoal grill set for indirect heat.
4. Place ribs in smoker or grill and cook, spraying often with remaining mixture, for 5–6 hours.
5. Remove and place on a medium-high heat charcoal grill, seasoned side down, spraying constantly until well-browned.
6. Remove and let rest for 5 minutes and serve.

title: Chipotle Lime Grilled Chicken
instructions:
1. Combine all ingredients except for BBQ Rub in a gallon zip-top plastic freezer bag. Add chicken breasts and refrigerate for 45 minutes.
2. Remove chicken from bag. Season each breast with BBQ Rub.
3. Place on a preheated charcoal grill and cook, turning often, until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
4. Remove and let rest for 5 minutes.
5. Serve.
ingredient_lines: ¼ cup freshly squeezed lime juice

title: Chipotle Ketchup
instructions:
1. Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan and bring to a boil over high heat. Cook, stirring occasionally, for ½ hour.
2. Refrigerate in a non-reactive container for up to 2 months.

title: Mexican Habanero Hot Sauce
instructions:
1. Combine all ingredients in a food processor and pulse until smooth.
2. Refrigerate in a non-reactive container for up to 2 months.

title: Crawfish Boil
instructions:
1. Bring water to a boil in a stockpot or your tallest pot. Stir in seasonings.
2. Add crawfish, making sure to leave any dead ones behind. Cook for 7 minutes.
3. Turn off the heat and leave on the burner for 8 minutes. This allows the crawfish to soak in and absorb the flavorful broth without overcooking.
4. Drain through a colander and serve.

title: Fish Sticks
instructions:
1. Combine all dry seasonings. Set aside.
2. Dip fish in lemon juice, season with seasoning mixture, then dredge in cornmeal.
3. Heat oil to 375°F. Fry fish in batches for 3 minutes. Drain on a cooling rack.
4. Cut into one strip. If inside is underdone, finish in a 350°F oven, not in the oil. Serve.
ingredient_lines: 1 pound cod, haddock, or tilapia fillets, cut in half

title: Rosemary Balsamic Chicken Wings
instructions:
1. Place chicken in a zip-top plastic bag. Combine remaining ingredients except for oil and cornmeal and refrigerate overnight.
2. Heat oil to 350°F. Meanwhile, dredge chicken in cornmeal. Fry in batches for 12 minutes. Drain on a cooling rack.
3. Rest 5 minutes and serve.

title: Spicy Fried Rice
instructions:
1. Heat the oil in a non-stick pan, and fry the big onion, garlic, red chilli, ginger, and scallion. Stir for about 30 minutes until fragrant.
2. Add the basmati rice, chilli powder, light soy sauce, fish sauce, chicken powder, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring, until well-mixed and heated through.
3. Serve hot.
ingredient_lines: 50 g red chile, cut into 1 cm pieces

title: Boston Baked Beans
instructions:
1. Cook bacon. Separate the meat from the fat, and chop the bacon.
2. Place 1 tbsp of the bacon fat into a large stainless steel pan. Add kidney beans and sauté over medium-high heat.
3. Add rum and tilt to ignite. If you do not have a gas stove, simply light with a fire stick.
4. Add remaining ingredients and chopped bacon and fold to combine.
5. Bake in a 325°F oven for 1 ½ hours, adding blackstrap molasses occasionally to prevent drying.
ingredient_lines: 6 rashers thick cut bacon, sliced (or 5 drops liquid smoke)
4 cups canned kidney beans, rinsed and drained
¼ cup blackstrap molasses, plus more as needed

title: Hickory Maple Glazed Wings
instructions:
1. Season chicken with salt and pepper.
2. Dip chicken in maple syrup, then dredge in cornmeal.
3. Heat oil to 350°F, add chicken pieces, and deep fry for 12 minutes. Drain on a cooling rack.
4. Combine 6 tbsp maple syrup with remaining ingredients. Add wings and toss to coat. Serve.
ingredient_lines: 36 chicken wingettes or 18 whole chicken wings, tips removed and halved
Maple syrup as needed plus 6 tbsp

title: Spicy Crab Cakes
instructions:
1. Combine all ingredients in a small bowl.
2. Combine all ingredients except for oil, panko, and egg. Shape into 4 equal patties.
3. Dip into egg then dredge in panko. Fry at 375°F just until heated through and golden brown.
4. Serve with chipotle remoulade sauce.
ingredient_lines: 1 tbsp chipotle in adobo sauce, puréed

title: Tangy Lemon Mousse
instructions:
1. Combine all ingredients except for whipped cream.
2. Gently fold in the whipped cream.
3. Refrigerate for 20 minutes and serve.
ingredient_lines: ¼ cup pasteurized egg product, or 2 pasteurized egg yolks, beaten
2 cups heavy cream, whipped to soft peaks

title: Grilled Pork Tenderloin
instructions:
1. Combine marinade ingredients in a small saucepan. Pour half into a large zip-top plastic bag, reserving the other half in the fridge. Add pork to the bag, remove extra air, and marinate in the fridge for 24 hours.
2. Remove pork from marinade. Discard the bag and the marinade in the bag. Allow the pork to drain as necessary.
3. Combine rub ingredients, and rub all over pork.
4. Moisten newspaper with oil and wad up under a large chimney starter with charcoal in it. Light and wait 15 minutes.
5. Once charcoal has heated, disperse evenly around bottom of grill. Add soaked chips, replace grate, and place pork in the center. Cover and cook for 1 ½ minutes (or a bit more, use your judgment).
6. Flip to another side and cook 1 ½ more minutes and repeat until pork has cooked for at least 12 minutes and until the internal temperature reaches at least 145°F (63˚C).
7. Make a large foil pouch (or use a covered dish) and place pork inside. Pour in reserved marinade (warmed to at least 145°F) and let rest for 10 minutes.
8. Serve.
ingredient_lines: 1 ea. (~2.25 lb / 1 kg) pork tenderloin, trimmed

title: Wine Glazed Pork Chops
instructions:
1. Brush pork chops generously with cider vinegar. Season pork with chop rub, patting down slightly.
2. Bring wine to a boil over high heat in a large saucepan, and ignite it. Cook until reduced by half.
3. Add butter, 1 tbsp at a time while whisking, until all butter has melted.
4. Grill pork chops over high heat 2 minutes, brushing with wine mixture, then rotate 90° and cook for 2 minutes, brushing. Flip to the other side and repeat 1 more time.
5. Remove and let rest 5 minutes. Serve with remaining wine mixture.
ingredient_lines: 4 thick cut bone-in pork rib chops

title: Black-Peppered Chicken Spaghetti
instructions:
1. Bring the water to a boil in a pot. Add the spaghetti and 2 tbsp oil. Boil for 10 minutes, then drain the spaghetti, reserving some cooking water.
2. Boil the chicken in salted water until the color changes. Drain the chicken.
3. Heat the remaining oil in a non-stick skillet. Add and fry the garlic, capsicum, and onion.
4. Add the drained chicken, cream, black pepper, salt, and parsley. Stir until well-combined.
5. Add the spaghetti, and toss together until well-mixed.
6. Serve hot.
ingredient_lines: 6 chicken fillets, cut into 2 cm pieces

title: Beef Yakiniku Pizza
instructions:
1. Combine flours, yeast, sugar, water, and salt to make a dough.
2. Cover with plastic wrap, and rest the dough 10 minutes until expanded.
3. Heat the oil in a non-stick pan. Add the onion and capsicum, and sauté for 10 seconds.
4. Add the tenderloin and the water. Add the mirin, soy sauce, and oyster sauce.
5. Add the dissolved cornflour, salt, and sugar. Stir until well-mixed and slightly thickened.
6. Separate the solids from the extra sauce. Reserve the sauce to serve with the pizza.
7. Roll out the pizza dough to a 10 cm diameter. Spread the meat topping on top.
8. Bake pizza in the oven at 220°C for 20 minutes.
9. Serve hot with the dipping sauces.
ingredient_lines: ½ red capsicum, cut into 10 pieces
600 g tenderloin beef, cut into 2 x 1 x 1 cm pieces
2 tbsp cornstarch, dissolved with 20 ml water

title: Mesquite Beef Tenderloin
instructions:
1. Place beef in a large zip-top plastic bag. Add cognac to cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
2. Place mesquite chips in the hot coal area of a charcoal grill.
3. Combine paprika, coriander, salt, pepper, rosemary, and lemon peel. Rub this mixture all over beef and bring to room temperature.
4. Place beef in center of grill, cover, and cook, turning often until internal temperature reaches 135°F for medium rare, 150°F for medium, or 160°F for toast.
5. Remove, let rest for 10 minutes, and serve.
ingredient_lines: ¾ cup soaked mesquite wood chips

title: Chipotle Fried Chicken
instructions:
1. Combine adobo sauce and lime juice and pour over chicken. Refrigerate overnight.
2. Remove chicken from adobo mixture. Combine the seasoning ingredients, and sprinkle over chicken.
3. Dredge chicken in cornmeal. Let rest for 2–3 minutes.
4. Meanwhile, heat shortening in a large cast-iron skillet to 350°F. Place breasts and legs around the edges, then place thighs in the center.
5. Cook for 12 minutes per side. Drain on a cooling rack and serve.
ingredient_lines: 2 ea. skinless chicken thighs, legs, and boneless skinless chicken breasts

title: Fry Seasoning for Chicken
instructions: 1. Combine all ingredients in an airtight container with a shaker lid.
ingredient_lines: 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce powder (you can find this easily on the Internet)

title: Poultry Shake
instructions: 1. Combine all ingredients, then place in an airtight container with a shaker lid.

title: Rosemary Garlic Pork Roast
instructions:
1. Generously brush pork with cider vinegar. Apply chop rub, pressing slightly to aid adhesion. Spray with non-stick cooking spray. Refrigerate at least 1 hour.
2. Place rosemary in the bottom of a roasting pan and place garlic in a circle around it. Place pork on top. Some may wish to be a bit bolder and make slits in the meat to insert the rosemary and garlic into the roast.
3. Insert an oven-safe probe thermometer into the center and bake at 375°F until internal temperature reaches 145°F.
4. Remove and let rest for 10 minutes. Serve.

title: Rosemary Garlic Oil
instructions:
1. Heat the oil in your tallest largest pot over low heat. Add remaining ingredients and warm for 1 hour.
2. Strain and keep in an airtight container. Some may want to keep this in the refrigerator, others may not.
ingredient_lines: ½ gallon any flavorless high-smoke point oil, such as canola, grapeseed, peanut, or safflower

title: Hot Wing Dip
instructions:
1. Combine cheese, cayenne, sour cream, garlic, and salt in a serving bowl.
2. Serve with celery and hot wings/Buffalo Wings.
ingredient_lines: 1 recipe Hot Wings or Buffalo Wings

title: Buffalo Wings
instructions:
1. Sprinkle chicken with the Poultry Shake.
2. Heat the oil to 350 °F (180°C). Add the chicken pieces to the hot oil, and fry for 11 minutes. Drain on a cooling rack.
3. Meanwhile, combine remaining ingredients. Add wings and toss to coat and serve.
4. Garnish with the chili leaves, if desired.
ingredient_lines: ½ cup Smoky Chipotle Hot Sauce

title: Cayenne Hot Sauce
instructions: 1. Combine all ingredients. Store indefinitely at room temperature in a squirt bottle.

title: Seafood Bruschetta
instructions:
1. In a bowl, combine prawn, crabstick, fishball, parsley, sugar, salt and black pepper. Stir with spoon until well-mixed.
2. Top each slice of baguette with some of the the topping mixture.
3. Bake the bruschetta at 190°C for 15 minutes.
4. Serve hot.
ingredient_lines: 300 g prawn, fried with 1 tbsp vegetable oil
8 crabsticks, cut into 6 parts and fried with 1 tbsp vegetable oil
5 fishballs, cut in circles and fried with 1 tbsp vegetable oil

title: Pattaya Fried Rice
instructions:
1. Heat the oil in a non-stick pan. When the oil is hot, fry the garlic and shallots, stirring until brown and fragrant.
2. Add the chicken pieces, carrot, green peas, and red chilli. Stir for 2 minutes.
3. Add the rice, nam pla, tomato sauce, salt, and pepper. Stir until all mixed.
4. To make the omelette, heat the oil in a separate pan. Beat the eggs, and pour into the pan. Cook until the egg is browned on the bottom.
5. Flip the egg over to cook on the other side.
6. Place a ball of the fried rice mixture in the center of the omelette. Fold up the 4 edges of the omelette to enclose the rice. Flip it onto a serving plate.
7. Serve hot.
ingredient_lines: 3 tbsp olive oil (2 tbsp for frying and 1 tbsp for making an omelette)
2 red chillies, cut in 1 cm dice
2 chicken fillets, cut in 1.5 cm pieces

title: Chicken Fried Rice
instructions:
1. Melt the butter in a non-stick pan. Fry the garlic, chilli, and scallion, stirring, for 15 seconds.
2. Add the chicken and carrot. Cook until the chicken changes color from pink to white.
3. Add the rice, then the oyster sauce, Worcestershire sauce, salt, and pepper. Continue to cook until well-combined.
4. Serve hot with the sides.
ingredient_lines: 2 red chiles, cut into 1 cm pieces

attribution: Wikibooks — Cookbook:Spice Rubbed Grilled Chicken Breast
title: Spice Rubbed Grilled Chicken Breast
instructions:
1. Combine paprikas, salt, pepper, rosemary, cayenne, cinnamon, and lemon peel. Set aside.
2. Rub mustard all over chicken. Apply seasoning mixture, and press lightly to aid adhesion.
3. Grill on a preheated charcoal grill, turning often, until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
4. Remove and let rest for 3 minutes. Serve.

title: Crab Fried Rice
instructions:
1. Stir fry the crab in the 5 tbsp oil for 1 minute. Remove from the heat, and reserve.
2. Heat the remaining oil, and use to stir fry the garlic, red onion, scallion, and red chillies for 1 minute until fragrant.
3. Add the fried crab and bean sprouts. Stir until the crab changes color.
4. Add the rice, fish sauce, salt, and black pepper. Stir until well-mixed.
5. Serve hot.
ingredient_lines: 150 g bean sprouts, soaked in hot water
2 big red chilli, cut into small pieces

title: Prime Rib Seasoning
instructions: 1. Combine all ingredients in an airtight container with a shaker lid.
ingredient_lines: ½ cup coarsely ground black pepper
¼ cup coarsely ground coriander seed

title: Barbecue Prime Rib
instructions:
1. Coat roast with oil. Shake on seasoning and massage into meat.
2. Place dry mesquite chunks into firebox of a 250°F smoker.
3. Insert a probe thermometer into center of roast and set for 118°F.
4. Place roast into smoker and lower heat to 200°F. Cook until internal temperature is achieved, changing mesquite as needed.
5. Remove and grill on high heat for 7 minutes or until desired crust is achieved.
6. Remove and let rest 10 minutes. Serve.
ingredient_lines: 1 ea. 4-bone standing rib roast, prime grade

title: Barbecue Beef Brisket Sandwiches
instructions:
1. Place mesquite into the firebox of a 250°F smoker.
2. Trim fat cap to ¼ inch. Place brisket into a large foil pouch and pour in vinegar mixture, Worcestershire sauce, and honey. Place pouch in smoker and cook for 6 hours, changing chunks as needed.
3. Remove brisket from pouch, spread mustard evenly on it, and massage Rub into meat. Place brisket back into smoker and cook for 10 hours, changing chunks as needed.
4. Separate brisket halves along fat line. Slice across the grain as thinly as humanly possible, chop roughly, and place serving portion in halved buns.
5. Place some vinegar mixture into a squirt bottle and serve with sandwiches.
ingredient_lines: ½ cup vinegar mixture from North Carolina-Style BBQ Ribs, plus more for serving

title: Chicken Marinade
instructions:
1. Combine all ingredients in a gallon size zip-top bag.
2. Refrigerate for up to 2 weeks before using to marinate chicken.
3. To use, proceed as directed in given recipe OR submerge chicken in marinade and let rest for several hours in the fridge before cooking.
ingredient_lines: ¼ cup (60 ml) extra-virgin olive oil
category_tags: Recipes using chicken broth and stock
notes: Do not store and/or reuse this marinade once it has been in contact with raw meat.

title: Barbecue Ribs
instructions:
1. Massage ribs with the barbecue rub. Refrigerate for 1 hour.
2. Combine remaining ingredients except for hickory in a large saucepan, and bring to a boil over high heat until reduced by ½.
3. Place hickory chunks in firebox of 250°F (120°C) smoker.
4. Place ribs in smoker and cook, brushing often with tomato mixture and changing the hickory chunks as needed, for 5–6 hours.
5. Brush ribs generously with mixture and grill on high heat, brushing repeatedly until well-browned on both sides.
6. Remove and let rest 10 minutes. Serve.

title: Barbecue Chicken
instructions:
1. Combine all brine ingredients in a 2-gallon zip-top bag. Insert chicken and refrigerate for 2 hours.
2. Combine sauce ingredients and bring to a boil over medium high heat until reduced by half.
3. Quickly swab the grill with an oiled towel tied with twine to lube.
4. Combine Rub ingredients and massage all over chicken. Refrigerate for 30 minutes.
5. Grill chicken over a preheated charcoal grill, turning often, for 10 minutes. Cook, turning often and brushing with sauce when turned, until internal temperature reaches 165°F in the breast and 170°F for the dark meat.
6. Cover with foil and let rest 7 minutes. Meanwhile, boil remaining sauce for 5 minutes and place in a squirt bottle. Serve chicken with sauce on the side.
ingredient_lines: 2 each chicken thighs, legs, and breasts
category_tags: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

title: Grill Seasoning
instructions:
1. Combine all ingredients in an airtight container with a shaker lid.
2. Use as desired or as directed in a given recipe.
ingredient_lines: ½ cup dried apples, finely minced in a food processor

title: Apple Glazed Pork Chops
instructions:
1. Rub seasoning on pork chops. Refrigerate for 30 minutes.
2. Meanwhile, combine remaining ingredients in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat, and cook until reduced by ⅓. Remove from heat and set aside.
3. Grill pork chops over high heat for 2 minutes, covered. Brush with cider mixture, rotate 90°, and cook for 2 minutes. Flip and repeat 1 more time.
4. Remove and let rest for 7 minutes. Serve with remaining cider mixture.
ingredient_lines: Grill Seasoning for Chops, as needed

attribution: Wikibooks — Cookbook:Maple Planked Salmon with Rum Glaze
title: Maple Planked Salmon with Rum Glaze
instructions:
1. Brush salmon with oil. Sprinkle liberally with salt and freshly ground black pepper.
2. Place salmon on plank. Heat grill to medium on one burner.
3. Bring rum to a boil in a saucepan over high heat. Remove from heat and ignite. Boil until reduced to ¼ cup.
4. Place plank on indirect heat and cook for 20 minutes, brushing often with rum.
5. Let rest 5 minutes. Serve.
ingredient_lines: 1 large untreated maple plank, soaked in water for at least 1 hour

title: Honey Teriyaki Spareribs
instructions:
1. Shake the grill seasoning on ribs and gently massage into meat. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
2. Combine remaining ingredients. Refrigerate until needed.
3. Place ribs into a large foil pouch. Pour in soy mixture and tilt to evenly distribute. Tightly crimp the edges to seal.
4. Bake at 250°F for 5 hours.
5. Snip foil pouch over a large saucepan to release liquid. Degrease and bring liquid to a boil over high heat for 5 minutes.
6. Brush generously on one side of ribs and either grill glaze side down over high heat or place glaze side up under a preheated broiler until nicely browned.
7. Slice into 1-rib portions and toss with some of the remaining soy mixture. Serve.
ingredient_lines: Grill Seasoning for Chops, as needed

title: Duck Fried Rice
instructions:
1. Heat the butter and sesame oil in a non-stick frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the garlic, chillies, and scallion. Fry, stirring, for 15 seconds until fragrant.
2. Add the duck meat, bean sprouts, and parsley. Stir until the duck meat changes color.
3. Add the rice, and then the soy sauce, habanero, black pepper, and salt. Stir until well-mixed.
4. Serve hot.
ingredient_lines: 200 g bean sprouts, soaked in hot water

title: Soy Ginger Barbecue Sauce
instructions:
1. Combine all ingredients in a mason jar.
2. Refrigerate for as long as either the soy sauce or the hoisin lasts, whichever comes first.

title: Steakhouse Marinade
instructions:
1. Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan.
2. Bring to 190°F for 10 minutes.
3. Strain, cool and place into a gallon size zip-top bag. Keep refrigerated for up to 1½ weeks.
category_tags: Recipes using beef broth and stock

title: Pork Marinade
instructions: 1. Combine all ingredients in a large mason jar. Keep refrigerated for up to 2 weeks.
category_tags: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

title: Chile Lime Marinade
instructions: 1. Combine all ingredients in a large mason jar and keep refrigerated for up to 2 weeks.
ingredient_lines: ½ cup (125 ml) freshly-squeezed lime juice
4 serrano chiles, minced (seeded if you want)
category_tags: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

title: Vegetable Salad
instructions:
1. Mix all the vegetables ingredients on a bowl, and allow to rest for until 5 minutes.
2. Mix all the sauce ingredients with spoon.
3. Place the sauce, reserving 2 tbsp, into the vegetable mixture, and then mix again.
4. Top with egg quarters, then top eggs with reserved sauce.
ingredient_lines: 300 g bean sprouts, washed in hot water
6 sheets lettuce, washed and cut into 6 pieces
6 cucumber, peeled and sliced 1 cm thick
4 hard-boiled eggs, each cut into 4 pieces

title: Smoky Chipotle Marinade
instructions: 1. Combine all ingredients in a large zip-top plastic bag. Insert meat in and refrigerate for as long as you like.
category_tags: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

title: Apple Bundt Cake
instructions:
1. Mix quickly the sugar and lemon rind in a food processor.
2. Add eggs and blend until it becomes a nice cream.
3. Continue blending while slowly adding the oil. Blend until well mixed and add vanilla.
4. In a separate bowl sift the dry ingredients all together (flour, allspice, nutmeg, baking powder, baking soda, salt and cinnamon).
5. Mix the dry ingredients slowly into the batter, blending until it becomes nice and thick.
6. Add grated apples and blend quickly into batter just to mix. Be sure not to overblend and shred the apples too much.
7. Add raisins, and pulse the processor as to just mix them in and not shred them.
8. Bake in a bundt pan for 55 minutes at approximately 320°F (160°C; gas mark 3) or until a knife inserted into the center comes out clean.
ingredient_lines: 2 cups (450 g / 16 oz) white granulated sugar
1 cup (250 ml / 8.5 fl oz) vegetable oil

title: Dry Rub Grilled Ribeye
instructions:
1. Spread a thin layer of mustard on both sides of each steak. Shake on steak rub liberally and gently massage into meat. Set aside.
2. Quickly wipe the towel on the grate of a preheated charcoal grill. Add steaks to the hottest part and cook 1 ½ minutes, then rotate 90° and cook for another 1 ½ minutes. Flip and repeat 1 more time. If flare-ups appear close to meat, spray with Worcestershire sauce. If not, leave alone.
3. Move to a cooler part of the grill and cook, turning often until 10°F below your desired doneness.
4. Remove and let rest for 10 minutes. Serve.
ingredient_lines: Worcestershire sauce in a spray bottle

title: Spicy Garlic Oil
instructions:
1. Combine all ingredients in a large stockpot.
2. Heat over low heat for 1 hour.
3. Strain, cool, and store in the refrigerator until oil smells off, looks smoky, or tastes rancid.
ingredient_lines: ½ gallon flavorless high smoke point oil, such as canola, peanut, safflower, grapeseed, or soybean
8 Thai bird chiles, stemmed and halved

title: Chicken Wings Asian Style
instructions:
1. Coat chicken with egg. Season chicken liberally with poultry shake.
2. Dredge chicken in cornmeal. Fry at 350°F (180°C) in batches, if needed for 12 minutes. Drain on a cooling or oven rack.
3. Combine remaining ingredients in a large bowl. Add wings and toss to coat.
ingredient_lines: Spicy garlic oil for deep frying

title: Dry-Aged Prime Rib
instructions:
1. Place roast in a paper towel-lined perforated box with a lid. Cover and refrigerate for 3 days, changing towels halfway.
2. If any leathery spots appear, trim them off. Rub roast all over with canola oil. Shake on prime rib seasoning liberally, and pat down lightly.
3. Insert an oven-safe probe thermometer into the roast. Bake at 200°F until internal temperature reaches 118°F.
4. Remove from oven and raise oven to 500°F. Insert roast back in, and bake until internal temperature reaches 135°F.
5. Remove, let rest 10 minutes, and serve.
ingredient_lines: 1 prime grade standing rib roast (4 bone)

title: Apple Stuffed Pork Chops
instructions:
1. Combine lemon juice, honey, and salt in a gallon-size zip-top bag. Add pork chops, take as much air out as possible, and seal bag. Refrigerate 24 hours.
2. Take pork out of marinade. Using a narrow boning knife, make an incision in the side of the chop until you hit bone. Sweep the knife up and make the hole slightly larger. Repeat with remaining pork chops. Using a bagel slicer helps to stabilize the chops while cutting.
3. Place the apple stuffing inside a gallon size zip top plastic bag. Snip a small hole in the corner. Place snipped corner inside incision in one of the pork chops. Squeeze to dispense. Dispense about 2 tbsp into each pork chop.
4. Once all pork has been stuffed, massage the chop rub into both sides of each chop. Set aside.
5. Quickly lube grill with the oiled towel. Grill pork over high heat 2 minutes, then rotate 90° and cook for another 2 minutes to get good grill marks. Flip and repeat 1 more time.
6. Remove from grill and let rest for 7 minutes. Serve.
ingredient_lines: A heat-proof towel tied with twine and soaked with oil

title: Apple Stuffing
instructions:
1. Combine all ingredients except cheese and egg whites. Gently fold in whipped egg whites, in a few batches.
2. Pour into a roasting pan. Top with shredded cheese and bake at 325°F for 30 minutes, or until browned and bubbly on top.
3. Remove and let rest for 7 minutes. Serve warm or use for Apple Stuffed Pork Chops.
ingredient_lines: 4 egg whites, beaten to stiff peaks with ⅛ tsp cream of tartar

title: Classic American Apple Pie
instructions:
1. Combine dough ingredients to get a mealy dough. Split in half by weight, shape into 2 disks, and chill for 1 hour.
2. Toss apples with ¼ cup sugar and place in a colander set over a large bowl. Let drain for 1 ½ hours.
3. Transfer liquid from bowl into a saucepan, and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Cook until reduced to 2 tbsp. Set aside.
4. Toss apples with remaining filling ingredients. Set aside.
5. Roll out both disks of crust into rough circles. Place one inside a 9 ½–10-inch tart pan and attach.
6. Add apples to the crust in a concentric circle, starting from the outside and working to the inside, making the center slightly taller than the outside. Pour any liquid in the bottom of the bowl over the apples.
7. Top with the second sheet of dough, and seal the edges. Crimp the edges if desired, then snip 3 incisions in the center. Brush top with reduced apple liquid.
8. Bake at 425°F on the floor of the oven in a half sheet pan lined with parchment for 30 minutes. Transfer to the lower rack, and bake for another 20 minutes.
9. Remove and cool for 4 hours. Serve.
ingredient_lines: 8 ounces cold butter, cut into ½-inch pieces
5–7 tbsp applejack (apple brandy) or hard cider
6 Honeycrisp apples, peeled, cored, and cut into 12ths
¼ tsp freshly-ground grains of paradise

title: Cheese Tart
instructions:
1. Mash together all ingredients except dough. Set aside.
2. Roll out dough into a rough circle. Place dough in a 10-inch tart pan to make a tart shell, and remove the excess dough from the edges.
3. Transfer the cheese mixture into tart shell and bake at 425°F on the bottom of the oven for 15 minutes. Move to the bottom rack and bake for 10 minutes more.
4. Remove and let rest 10 minutes. Serve.
ingredient_lines: ½ cup Brie cheese, rind removed
½ dough from Classic American Apple Pie, made with mascarpone cheese instead of applejack

title: Barbecue Fried Rice
instructions:
1. Heat the olive oil and sesame oil in a non-stick pan. Fry the garlic and red onion until fragrant. Stir until the garlic and red onion are golden brown.
2. Add the red chilli and pork. Stir until the pork changes color.
3. Add horseradish, scallion, rice, barbecue sauce, black soy sauce, salt, and pepper. Stir until well-mixed.
4. Serve with toppings as desired.
ingredient_lines: 2 red chillies, cut into 1 cm pieces
Vegetables like corn, carrot, and peas

title: Coffee Rum Glazed Apples
instructions:
1. Melt 1 tbsp butter in a stainless steel skillet over medium heat. Add apples and sauté just until browned around edges. Remove and keep warm.
2. Meanwhile, combine liqueurs. Add to pan, turn heat off, and ignite. Bring to a boil and start scraping browned bits.
3. Add remaining ingredients to pan and bring to a boil over medium heat until reduced by ⅓.
4. Add apples and toss to coat.
5. Serve warm.
ingredient_lines: 3 Honeycrisp apples, peeled, cored, and sliced into 12ths

title: Hamburger Fried Rice
instructions:
1. Heat the canola oil in a non-stick frying pan. When the oil is very hot, fry the garlic, red onion, ginger, and red chillies. Stir every 20 seconds until fragrant.
2. Add the hamburger meat, and cook until the meat browns and is cooked through.
3. Add the celery and scallion. Add the rice, salt, black pepper, and black soy sauce. Cook until well mixed and heated through.
4. Serve hot.
ingredient_lines: 4 cloves red onion, sliced 0.5 cm thick

title: BBQ Pork Fried Rice
instructions:
1. Combine the barbecue sauce, soy sauce, hoisin sauce, sugar, and salt to make the marinade.
2. Place the pork into the sauce mixture. Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for 25 minutes. Make sure the sauce in the bowl is really absorbed.
3. Transfer the pork to a baking pan, and bake for 20 minutes at {{#invoke:temperature|c|200}}. When finished, put the pork onto a plate.
4. Heat the olive oil and sesame oil in a medium wok. Fry the garlic, red chillies, ginger and scallion, then stir briefly for 1 minute. Add the mixed egg and rice.
5. Add the grilled pork, salted soy sauce, chicken powder, oyster sauce, salt and jalapeño. Stir until mixed.
6. Serve hot with garnishes.
ingredient_lines: 1 piece (750 g) boneless pork loin, cut into 30 pieces
3 eggs, cooked into an omelette and sliced 1 cm thick (as garnish)

attribution: Wikibooks — Cookbook:Grilled Bananas with Coffee Syrup
title: Grilled Bananas with Coffee Syrup
instructions:
1. Combine all ingredients except bananas in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium high heat until reduced to ½ cup. Remove from heat and set aside.
2. Brush bananas liberally with coffee mixture. Grill over medium high heat just until marked and slightly charred.
3. Remove from heat, peel, and drizzle several more spoonfuls of syrup over bananas. Serve with remaining syrup on the side.

title: Shrimp Curry
instructions:
1. Heat oil in a large stainless steel sauté pan over medium high heat. Add shrimp and sauté just until bright pink. Remove and keep warm.
2. Melt ghee in same pan. Add vegetables and sauté until browned around edges.
3. Add remaining ingredients and shrimp and toss to coat. Reduce heat to medium low and cook until shrimp are heated through.
4. Remove and serve.
ingredient_lines: 1 pound peeled, deveined jumbo shrimp, heads removed
category_tags: Recipes using chicken broth and stock

title: Apple Stuffed Pork Loin
instructions:
1. Make a slit in the top center of the roast about 1¼ inch deep. Fill with Apple Stuffing. Brush opening with Dijon mustard, and press closed.
2. Brush roast with olive oil and liberally shake on grill seasoning. Set aside until needed.
3. Grill on a preheated charcoal grill, turning often, until internal temperature reaches 140°F.
4. Remove and let rest 7 minutes. Serve.

title: Fast Food French Fries
instructions:
1. Place potatoes in a large container of clean water. Rinse repeatedly until water runs clear.
2. Spin potatoes in a salad spinner until dry. Deep fry at 350°F until tender and limp but not browned. Drain on a cooling rack.
3. Heat oil to 375°F, and fry potatoes for 4–5 minutes.
4. Drain fries on a cooling rack, and sprinkle heavily with salt and freshly ground black pepper.
5. Serve hot.
ingredient_lines: 2 pounds russet potatoes, cut slightly larger than julienne

title: Apple BBQ Sauce
instructions:
1. Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan and bring to a boil over medium high heat.
2. Cook until reduced to 4 cups.
3. Keep refrigerated for up to 3 weeks in a large mason jar or a squirt bottle.

attribution: Wikibooks — Cookbook:Southwestern Black Beans and Rice
title: Southwestern Black Beans and Rice
instructions:
1. In medium saucepan, combine beans, tomatoes and green chiles mix, and cumin.
2. Heat through.
3. Serve over hot rice.
ingredient_lines: 10 ounce can tomatoes and green chiles
notes: Ro-Tel makes canned tomatoes and green chiles.

title: Cheeseburgers
instructions:
1. Pass meat cubes through a meat grinder set to fine. Once all ground, mix and form into 4 patties.
2. Brush patties with olive oil and sprinkle liberally with Steak Rub.
3. Grill on high for about 3–4 minutes per side for medium rare, 5–6 for medium, and 7–8 for well-done. During the last minute, place one slice of cheese on top.
4. Remove and place one patty on top of each bottom half of halved buns.
5. Top with your favorite condiments and finish with the top half. Serve.
ingredient_lines: 8 ounces chuck, trimmed and cut into 1½-inch cubes
8 ounces sirloin, trimmed and cut into 1½-inch cubes
4 slices of your favorite cheese (e.g. pepper jack)

title: Mushroom Fried Rice
instructions:
1. Heat the oil in a non-stick pan, and fry the garlic and big onion until fragrant.
2. Add the prawn and minced chicken fillet. Stir fry until the prawn and the chicken change color.
3. Add the button mushroom, enoki mushroom, and shitake mushroom. Then, add the rice together with oyster sauce, chicken powder, salt, and hoisin sauce.
4. Serve hot with garnishes.
ingredient_lines: ½ pack shiitake mushrooms, washed and sliced
category_tags: Recipes using chile paste and sauce

title: Creamy Mascarpone Dessert
instructions:
1. Whisk yolks and sugar in a stainless steel bowl until light and creamy.
2. Place the bowl on top of a pot of 1 inch simmering water to create a double boiler.
3. Whisk yolks non-stop, until warmed, thickened, and falling off the whisk in ribbons. Set aside until needed.
4. Fold together egg yolks, mascarpone, cream, and vanilla.
5. Pour a small amount of chocolate syrup into the bottom of a glass dish.
6. Fill with cheese mixture.
7. Top with crushed cookies and chocolate curls. Refrigerate before serving.
8. Place a serving portion into each plate. Smooth out into a small rectangle.
9. Place a dollop of whipped cream on top, and dust the whole thing with cocoa powder.
ingredient_lines: Crushed vanilla cookies and semi-sweet chocolate curls for topping

title: Fruit Cake
instructions:
1. Combine egg yolks, butter, sugar, and cake emulsifier in an electric mixer. Whip until light and expanded.
2. Combine the flour, baking soda, and grated orange. Fold into the egg yolk mixture.
3. Grease a baking pan with butter.
4. Transfer the batter to the prepared baking pan. Bake for 20 minutes at 360°F (185°C) until an inserted skewer comes out clean.
5. Let cake cool, and transfer to a serving plate.
6. Spread all sides of cake with the whipped cream.
7. Garnish with orange, strawberry and kiwifruit, and serve.

title: Barbecue Potato Chips
instructions:
1. Heat oil to 375°F.
2. Add potatoes to hot oil one slice at a time, working in batches as needed. Fry potatoes for 4–5 minutes. Drain on a cooling rack.
3. Once all potatoes have been fried, sprinkle liberally with the barbecue rub.
4. Serve.
ingredient_lines: 1 pound Russet potatoes, sliced thinly on a mandoline
notes: Don't fry too many potato slices at once—doing so will cause the oil temperature to drop.

title: Pouch-Roasted Snapper
instructions:
1. Rinse the couscous, then sprinkle with kosher salt and allow to sit for 10 minutes.
2. Lay the fish diagonally on a parchment-lined baking pan. Sprinkle liberally with salt and black pepper, inside and out. Stuff with the herbs and several slices of lemon. Place remaining lemon slices under fish.
3. Run couscous through a sieve all around the fish. Drizzle Worcestershire sauce and white white over fish. Dollop butter all over top.
4. Top with another piece of parchment and staple shut.
5. Bake at 425°F (about 215°C) for 30 minutes. Open with a paring knife and serve.
ingredient_lines: 1 whole (2 lb/1 kg) red snapper, cleaned, fins removed, head and tail intact
½ large bunch each of dill, oregano, thyme, and parsley
¼ cup butter, cut into small cubes

title: Holiday Stuffing
instructions:
1. Combine all ingredients, and transfer to a greased baking dish.
2. Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 45 minutes or until browned on top. If not browned, place under the broiler until browned.
3. Serve with roast turkey, cranberry sauce, yams, and all the other fixins.
ingredient_lines: ½ cup dried apples, finely diced
notes: You may wish to add some chicken or turkey broth.

title: Chipotle Fish n' Chips
instructions:
1. Make the chipotle vinegar by whisking all ingredients in a dipping bowl. Keep at room temperature until needed.
2. Combine beer, cornmeal, old bay, worcestershire sauce, salt, chipotles, and adobo to make a batter.
3. Dredge fish pieces in cornstarch, and then dip in the batter.
4. Fry coated fish pieces two at a time in the oil at 350°F. They should take 3 minutes to become golden and crisp on the outside.
5. Drain fish pieces on a cooling rack suspended above a baking pan. If inside is undercooked, finish in a 350°F oven.
6. Serve with French fries and the chipotle vinegar.
ingredient_lines: 2-3 canned chipotle chiles in adobo, pureed until smooth
3–4 canned chipotle chiles in adobo, pureed until smooth
1 recipe French fries, instead of black pepper use chipotle powder

title: Herb Grilled Snapper
instructions:
1. Coat fish with olive oil, then sprinkle liberally with salt and freshly-ground black pepper, inside and out.
2. Stuff cavity with herbs, garlic, onion, and lemon. Score skin in a diamond pattern.
3. Combine seafood stock and white wine in a gallon size zip-top plastic bag. Insert fish, remove as much air as possible, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
4. Grill over medium high heat for 6–8 minutes per side. Remove and rest for 7 minutes. Serve.
ingredient_lines: 1 ea. (2 lb) whole red snapper, cleaned, fins removed and head and tail left intact
Several thin slices of red onion
category_tags: Recipes using seafood broth and stock

title: Dutch Oven Beans
instructions:
1. Cut bacon into bite-sized pieces and begin cooking in heated Dutch oven.
2. Chop onion into ½-inch pieces.
3. When bacon is nearly cooked, crumble ground beef and chopped onion into Dutch oven. Cook until onion is translucent.
4. Add all the beans, ketchup, brown sugar, mustard, molasses, and Worcestershire sauce. Stir mixture.
5. Heat to a simmer and let bubble lightly for 10 or 15 minutes or as long as you can stand it.
6. Stir in liquid smoke.
7. Taste and adjust with additional ketchup, brown sugar, mustard, molasses, and Liquid Smoke or whatever it takes.
ingredient_lines: 1 large can (53 ounces) pork and beans
notes: About two dozen charcoal briquettes, started earlier until covered with white ash, with a dozen below and a dozen on top of the Dutch oven should bear sufficient heat. If dried beans are used, many more will be needed over the hours, as the original briquettes are exhausted.
Crowder peas or black-eyed peas may also be used.

If dried beans are used, add 12 cups of soaked beans to cooked bacon, hamburger, and onions, add the ketchup, brown sugar, mustard, molasses, and Worcestershire sauce, add enough water to make a thick soup and cook until beans are soft-maybe 6 to 8 hours, longer at higher altitudes.
Avoid eating this for too many consecutive days or your camp mates will move your campsite downwind.

title: Stuffed Grilled Chicken Breasts
instructions:
1. Using a narrow boning knife, make a slit along the side of one of the chicken breasts, almost cutting through all the way through the side. Repeat with remaining chicken.
2. Place stuffing inside a gallon size zip-top bag. Snip a small hole in one of the corners. Squeeze to dispense. Stuff each chicken breast until slit fills up halfway. Brush opening edge with Dijon mustard and press down lightly.
3. Coat chicken with mustard and season liberally with Grill Seasoning. Massage seasoning in.
4. Quickly swab preheated charcoal grill with oil soaked towel. Grill chicken, turning often, until area under stuffing reaches 165°F (75°C) and stuffing reaches 165°F (75°C).
5. Remove and let rest for 7 minutes. Serve.
ingredient_lines: Grill Seasoning for Chicken, as needed
1½ cups poultry stuffing (prepared to a somewhat wet and pipeable state)

title: Homemade Pancake Mix
instructions:
1. Combine all ingredients, mixing well.
2. Transfer to an airtight container.
3. Store at room temperature, and use within 3 months.
4. Preheat a griddle or frying pan to 350°F.
5. Combine buttermilk with egg whites, then combine melted butter with egg yolks. Combine the two mixtures.
6. Pour wet mixture over dry mixture and stir for 10 seconds only. Walk away if you feel the need to stir more.
7. Grease griddle with butter and wipe with paper towels until you can't see it.
8. Gently ladle the pancake batter onto the griddle and sprinkle on fruit if desired. When bubbles begin to set around the edges of the pancake and the griddle-side of the cake is golden, gently flip the pancakes. Continue to cook 2–3 minutes or until the pancake is set.
9. Serve.
ingredient_lines: Additional butter as needed for cooking

attribution: Wikibooks — Cookbook:Baked Brie in Puff Pastry
title: Baked Brie in Puff Pastry
instructions:
1. Place block of cheese in the middle of sheet of pastry.
2. Trim off about ½ inch of pastry, and fold pastry over cheese. When you reach the last fold, brush the fold with beaten egg to seal the pastry together.
3. Brush top with egg and bake at 375 °F for 15 minutes.
4. Cool 10 minutes and serve.
ingredient_lines: 1 block (10 ounces) Brie cheese, rind removed and brought to room temperature

attribution: Wikibooks — Cookbook:40 Cloves in a Roast Chicken
title: 40 Cloves in a Roast Chicken
instructions:
1. Rub the Country Roast Chicken Seasoning under the skin of the chicken. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
2. Tie the chicken's legs together and wing tips under the back with butcher's twine.
3. Heat garlic in a microwave on low for 6 minutes.
4. In this step, work quickly. If using a bag, place garlic in and stuff it in the cavity. If not, just stuff it in.
5. Coat chicken with olive oil. Place herbs in the bottom of a roasting pan and put lemon slices on top.
6. Put chicken breast side up on top and bake in an oven for 45 minutes at  375°F (190°C).
7. Turn the temperature up to 425°F (220°C) and bake for 45 more minutes or until the internal temperature in both the thigh and breast reaches 165°F (75°C) and the juices run clear.
8. Let rest for 10 minutes and serve.
